title: A Gentleman's Kiss
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yakuza heir Homura Yasobe and businessman Touji Karasuma have been secret lovers for four years, though their families and groups are long-standing rivals. As Touji is set to take over his family and group, discovery could mean war between them. A two-volume adult boys' love drama.
life_message: Love can hold out against family duty and rivalry, but it costs secrecy and risk.
